podcast.body: Option 30, a band featuring a young Trent Reznor, played a cover version of this song. Their rendition was described as having a unique, Appalachian-style arrangement that incorporated a washboard and harmonica, recorded spontaneously in 1983. "And another song that you guys play is the commas art, which is pretty familiar when everybody likes to dance to. Yeah, this is our version."
